saudi-arabien-x-twitter-religioese-dissi.note: Review: abgelehnt - The persecution itself is well documented: a joint statement co-signed by Freedom House and HRW (2024-09-06) and Amnesty 2023 confirm al-Sadhan's 20-year sentence for satirical tweets. But no search turned up a documented AI or algorithmic element. Dissidents were identified through infiltrators inside Twitter (human spies), troll farms and an 'electronic army' (Amnesty, NYT/Foreign Policy). The claimed 'KI-Klassifikation' in Freedom on the Net 2024 could not be found, and the al-Qarni case was not confirmed. The candidate also bundles several events from 2014-2024 with no single dated event (startDate 2024-01 is arbitrary). Rejected: not AI-related (AI element not documented) and no clearly bounded incident.

indonesia-ahmadiyya-lombok-social-media-.note: Review: abgelehnt - Rest of World (2024) confirms that local authorities monitor the social media of the Ahmadiyya in the Lombok shelter and that their movements are restricted. Amnesty and the Jakarta Post confirm the shelter's history since 2006. This is conventional, human surveillance, though. The central AI claim ('MUI und Hardliner nutzen KI-Detection-Tools') could not be found in any source. The part about the 2026 criminal code is speculative ('wird hebeln') and has no documented harm. Rejected: no AI or algorithmic element, and the core claim is speculative.
